SharedStake suffered an insider exploit in June 2021 due to a critical flaw in its timelock vesting contracts. The SmartTimelock contract allowed the beneficiary to execute arbitrary calls, permitting immediate withdrawal of locked funds. The attacker drained approximately $500,000 in tokens, collapsing confidence in the protocol. The SmartTimelock contract exposed a call() method that allowed the owner (beneficiary) to execute arbitrary contract calls on behalf of the timelock, without restricting the function selector or target. This enabled the withdrawal of locked assets before their scheduled release.
